#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
umask 077
export GENOS_PATCH_DEV="${GENOS_DEV_ROOT:-${GENOS_DEV:-$HOME/DEV}}"
task_logs="$PWD/fact-reason-r1-logs"
if ! mkdir -p -- "$task_logs"; then task_logs="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/8-agent-fact-reason-$(id -u)"; mkdir -p -- "$task_logs"; fi
task_log="$task_logs/$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)-$$.log"
exec > >(tee -a "$task_log") 2>&1
trap 'task_exit=$?; printf "FACT_REASON_EXIT=%s LOG=%s\n" "$task_exit" "$task_log"; printf "%s\n" "$task_exit" > "$task_log.exit"' EXIT
printf 'FACT_REASON_LOG=%s\n' "$task_log"
if [[ -n "${GENOS_PYTHON_DIR:-}" ]]; then export PATH="$GENOS_PYTHON_DIR:$PATH"; elif [[ -x /venv/bin/python3 ]]; then export PATH="/venv/bin:$PATH"; fi
if [[ $# -eq 0 ]]; then set -- check; fi
python3 - "$@" <<'FACT_REASON_PY'
import base64,hashlib,json,os,sys,types,zlib
raw=zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(''))
assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()=='01cc2319d35c812066fb989113db9df478c3a89706f377c170d7e010d9981964'
bundle=json.loads(raw);module=types.ModuleType('fact_reason_installer')
exec(compile(base64.b64decode(bundle['code']),'apply_patch.py','exec'),module.__dict__)
raise SystemExit(module.main(bundle['spec'],['--root',os.environ['GENOS_PATCH_DEV'],*sys.argv[1:]]))
FACT_REASON_PY
